newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat tradeless in drifting market.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat tradeless in drifting market.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat did not trade on Tuesday as the market drifted down.
The settlement price for the nearby July contract firmed by 50 cents to A$192.50 but all other settlement prices were either steady or down by A$1.00 to A$3.00 a tonne.

Australia's official commodities forecaster, the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE), earlier on Tuesday confirmed trade expectations by boosting its forecast of Australia's 1997/98 wheat crop to 19.2 million tonnes from its previous forecast of 17.8 million. Australia produced a record 23.59 million tonnes in the 1996/97 season.
